page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, right of centre; a strip of text at the left edge (cut-off lines of the facing page, not transcribed as main text beyond the visible fragments); signature mark and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: infolens, & quem tot alia premunt incommoda ? Fieri non potest, iniquam : Illi contra, At fieri oportet. Tunc ego mecum, Jam ergo teneris: nec est aut elabendi spes, aut deliberandi locus. Sed bono es animo; Non est impossibile, nisi nos dialectici fallant, quodcunque est necessarium :--- Ἀνάγκης ἐνῇ ... Audendum ergo aliquid; & nunc tertium, quod a te bis antea factum est, necessitati parendum. Protinus ergo & calamum et chartas, & scrinia posco : & dum meditor (pro more publice profitentium) aliquid ipso in limine præfari, quod apud humanitatem vestram habiturum esset justæ excusationis instar, dum eam in rem scriptur io nescio quid subsecivis horis & subsultoria opera; exit tandem de re nihili, hoc est de me, & de rebus, factis, consiliis meis jejuna hæc & ( ut vereor) nimium importuna narratiuncula.

page.notes: The Greek phrase "Ἀνάγκης ἐνῇ..." is partly illegible in the scan; the transcription of it is approximate. The left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. The catchword "Quæ" is partly illegible.
